question: Should OpenClaw core accept a new public `openclaw catalog` CLI, plugin descriptor metadata contract, and prompt projection now, and should this broad draft be the landing vehicle?
rationale: The branch changes public CLI output shape, plugin author metadata fields, and model-visible prompt guidance; automation can flag defects, but cannot choose the product/API boundary or review shape.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrowed Catalog Contract
options.body: Approve the direction but require a split or narrowed stack with restored glossary entries, conflict resolution, contract docs/tests, and real CLI proof before merge.

options.title: Keep As RFC For Now
options.body: Use this draft for design discussion and replace it with a smaller issue or PR once node/operator requirements are confirmed.

options.title: Land This Stack After Fixes
options.body: Let this PR remain the landing vehicle after blockers and proof are resolved, accepting the larger review surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor A Narrowed Catalog Contract
recommendation.body: Approve the direction but require a split or narrowed stack with restored glossary entries, conflict resolution, contract docs/tests, and real CLI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent broad CLI/plugin/product-surface history makes this the best available routing owner for the core direction choice.
